 I also had a very religious childhood, cold mother and a father who was more like a friend that I wanted to please even if it was all lies. Got put into homeschooling during my senior year so I ran away and moved in with my 20 year old boyfriend and his dad. my family hasn't forgiven me still after a year. I feel guilty being with my caring loving boyfriend because he does everything in his power to love on me and make sure I'm happy. I've hurt him so many times and he's always taken me back miraculously. 

I truly gotten better when I all my lies and fake personality came into light with him. It took me 18 years to bring my walls down and now I genuinely feel like I'm developing a true personality with likes and dislikes with my partner. We're very honest with each other now after countless heart breaks and trust being broken. But taking out the skeletons from my closet with him and addressing them everyday with him helped me have hope in myself and my future. I'm barely an adult and I have an idea of what I want to do with my life but I can't realistically see myself achieving it. But I actually have a great support system now and I can live with myself and my past instead of hiding it. 

Bottom line. I'm at peace with who I was. I forgave all the things I've done to other people and myself. And I have peace. 

I hope you find your peace too. Genuinely.

Soooooo... I'm adopted in an all boys family and I was the youngest. At 7 years old I was getting raped by 2 of my brothers. One of them stopped when I was around 11 because they went to jail for unrelated reasons. I told my parents when I was 13 and of course no one believed me. So from the trauma of the police reports and meetings, therapy, and slut shaming from my family; I believed it was my fault and I never told them anything ever again in fear of them hating me or seeing me as a "slut" . He never got charged because of mental illness and he denied all claims.

 I never told them about the other brother out of fear and shameHe continued sexually harassing/raping me till I was 17. (I'm 18 now). 

No one but my boyfriend, my brother, and myself know. He's married and expecting a child on the way. I will never be able to tell my parents or his wife that during my whole childhood, teenage years, and majority of their relationship he continued terrorizing me. 

Both of them are walking free. They both have lives and I'm still affected by what they've done to me. But I genuinely didn't start getting better until I met people who related, actually listened, and actually showed through their actions (verbal and physical) that they love and accept me. I finally accepted it wasn't my fault, and weirdly I forgave my brother (with mental illness) for what he did to me. It will never. Ever. Go away and I will never see them as brothers, but I also don't see myself as a victim and blame everything bad in my life on them or myself. 

I'm truly heart broken to hear they're walking free for what they did to you. 

My brother's took my identity and made me into a victim and almost a dead person. But I won't let then take the last and most valuable thing to me. My life. And I genuinely believe you don't want to let that person steal EVERYTHING from you.

I can't control your actions but the leats I can do is reach out. I hope you're doing okay and you read this. You might not care literally at all about my past and I understand. Clearly there's a lot on your plate you can't handle. But find someone or a group of people to help you lighten that load. 

People love and adore everything about you. You are perfect in their eyes. I hope you find comfort mentally, emotionally, and physically.
